messages:
maria: quick design review please — iterating on a more compact pool card for Capacity controls. goal is to reduce vertical height for lists of pools while adding a ‘Burst’ toggle and clearer min/max controls. screenshot + proto: https://redwood.design/s/compact-pool-card.png :eyes:
ashley: thanks — looks promising. two quick asks: 1) microcopy for Burst (users confuse it with 'burst to another pool'), 2) keyboard/aria behavior for the inline steppers.
kevin: copy thought — instead of ‘Burst’ maybe ‘Temporary burst (minutes)’ with a tooltip: “Adds extra GPUs for up to X minutes to handle spikes. Billing applies only while bursting.” shorter label: `Burst (min)`?
liam: accessibility nits: steppers must expose `aria-label` + `aria-valuetext` for screen readers. when the burst toggle flips on, focus should go to the minutes input. also color contrast on the SLO guardrail chips is borderline at 3:1.
ashley: good call. proposed copy options (vote please):
- Option A: `Burst — add temporary capacity (up to 60 min)`
- Option B: `Burst (time-limited)` with `?` tooltip explaining billing
- Option C: `Burst — short-lived extra GPUs`
which reads best in a dense list?
maria: leaning A because it sets expectation and time in-line. but it's long for narrow cards. maybe use A on hover and B in collapsed state.
kevin: UX trade: compact list shows `Burst` badge only, clicking opens a tiny popover with the minutes stepper and a CTA `Enable burst`. keeps list tidy and discoverable.
ashley: prototype approach: show badge + `...` affordance on hover. clicking opens an inline popover with controls. sample aria snippet for the minutes input: 
```
<input type=\"number\" aria-label=\"Burst duration minutes\" aria-valuemin=\"1\" aria-valuemax=\"180\" />
```
liam: also make sure `Enable burst` is tabbable and has an `aria-pressed` state for the toggle. for color/contrast I'll drop the chip background to #f2f4f7 and use #0b3d91 text — tested at 4.2:1.
ux-bot: heuristic check: compact card aims for <= 48px row height. current prototype is 56px. suggestion: collapse timestamp + region into secondary line only on hover.
maria: good point — target 48px. Ashley, can you try collapsing region into tooltip and remove the subtitle by default?
ashley: will iterate. one more tiny copy ask — min/max steppers currently labeled `Min`/`Max`. suggestion: replace with icons + `aria-labels` to save space, but keep full text on hover for clarity.
kevin: +1 for icons + aria. also think about an explicit guardrail state when SLO slider is near 0 or 100 — small warning icon with `Set lower bound to ensure baseline capacity` copy.
liam: add keyboard shortcuts for quick +/- on steppers: `alt+up`/`alt+down` to nudge by 1, `shift+alt` to nudge by 10. announce changes via live region: `aria-live=\"polite\"` text: "Pool min updated to N".
maria: actionable list: 1) Ashley to push two compact variants (badge+popover, badge+inline) 2) Use copy Option A in expanded, B in collapsed 3) Implement aria labels/snippets from Ashley/Liam 4) Kevin to draft guardrail tooltip copy 5) UX-bot to re-run density heuristic. deadline EOD Wednesday.
ashley: noted, I'll upload updated frames by tomorrow morning and ping here. :thumbsup:
kevin: I'll write the guardrail microcopy and post examples.
liam: will validate contrast & keyboard before final.
ux-bot: reminder scheduled: density check will run 2026-03-24T09:00Z and post results in this thread.
